title: Tiempo de pop up!
style: Electro-swing with a modern pop production. Features a baritone male vocal and a female vocal ensemble. Instrumentation includes a syncopated upright bass, a swing-time drum kit with a prominent snare, and a brass section consisting of trumpets and saxophones performing staccato stabs. A clean electric guitar plays rhythmic off-beat chords. The track features record scratch effects and vocal sampling. Key of G minor, 124 BPM, 4/4 time signature.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[upright bass, swing drums, record scratch]
I'm stuck [brass stabs]
On the ball
Can't hold me back
Because I stand tall

[Verse 1]
Feet are on fire
Feel them burn (num-num-num-ma)
Lift me up higher
That's what I yearn (num-num-num-ma)

[Chorus]
It's pickle time
It's time to pickle on rhythm headers as you know what time it is
It's pickle time
Listening to the track got the next set on my back
Let's bounce and drop it
Let's bounce and drop it
Let's bounce and drop it, drop it, drop it, drop it, drop it

[Bridge]
Bring it down, down, down, down, down, down, down, down, down, down, down
[vocal riser]
Oh!

[Outro]
[brass hits]
Pop up, pop-pop-pop-pop-pop-pop-pop-pop-pop-pop-pop-pop-pop-pop-pop-pop
Mmm
Pop up
